PLAN "12-Week Cardiac-Safe General Fitness"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve general strength and conditioning safely"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Introduction (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Full Body Intro":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Low Impact Conditioning":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 6x2m rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bodyweight_lunge_placeholder 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cycling 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Upper/Lower Balanced":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
